parents_rabbir_hamhuma.title: The Primary Du'a for Mercy
parents_rabbir_hamhuma.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.
parents_rabbir_hamhuma.benefit: Allah directly commands believers in Surah Al-Isra to lower their wings of humility to their parents and recite this du'a. It is the most famous and frequently recited supplication for parents in Islam.
parents_rabbir_hamhuma.occasion: Recite for your living or deceased parents at any time, especially after every prayer.

parents_rabbanaghfir.title: Du'a of Prophet Ibrahim for Forgiveness
parents_rabbanaghfir.arabicText: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
parents_rabbanaghfir.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lilmu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
parents_rabbanaghfir.translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
parents_rabbanaghfir.benefit: Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him) made this comprehensive supplication asking forgiveness for himself, his parents, and the entire Ummah on the Day of Judgment. Following the du'a of a great prophet is a powerful act of worship.
parents_rabbanaghfir.occasion: Recite for yourself, your parents, and all believers at any time.

parents_rabbighfir_nuh.title: Du'a of Prophet Nuh for Forgiveness
parents_rabbighfir_nuh.arabicText: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
parents_rabbighfir_nuh.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa liwalidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minat.
parents_rabbighfir_nuh.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women.
parents_rabbighfir_nuh.benefit: This beautiful supplication by Prophet Nuh (peace be upon him) expands the circle of mercy — including not just parents but anyone who enters the believer's home in faith, and all believing men and women everywhere.
parents_rabbighfir_nuh.occasion: Recite for your parents, household, and all believers at any time.

parents_rabbi_awzini.title: Du'a for Gratitude and Righteousness
parents_rabbi_awzini.arabicText: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
parents_rabbi_awzini.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati, inni tubtu ilayka wa inni minal-muslimeen.
parents_rabbi_awzini.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
parents_rabbi_awzini.benefit: Allah revealed this du'a specifically for a person who reaches maturity (traditionally at forty). It is a comprehensive supplication combining gratitude for parents' blessings, a request for righteous deeds, a prayer for one's children, and a declaration of repentance and submission to Allah.
parents_rabbi_awzini.occasion: Recite at any age, especially meaningful at the age of forty or upon reaching major life milestones.
